## Problem

What is difficult or missing today?

What would you like DrishtiX to do?

## Alternatives considered

Any workaround you use now.

## Scope check

DrishtiX is local-first by design. Requests that add telemetry, cloud sync, or
photo uploads will be declined. Requests that modify original media are also
out of scope.
